source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00QX (lemma-limit-module-essentially-finite-presentation, line 32427) and its proof ('We leave it to the reader to see that this works'), with the construction of the proof of Lemma Tag 00QV (lemma-limit-essentially-finite-presentation, line 32346): $T\cong(A[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m))_{\mathfrak q}$, $f_j$ descended to $A_{\lambda}[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $T_\lambda=(A_\lambda[x]/(f_{1,\lambda},\dots,f_{m,\lambda}))_{\mathfrak q_\lambda}$ with $\mathfrak q_\lambda$ the inverse image of $\mathfrak q$, and $N_\lambda=\operatorname{Coker}(A_\lambda\text{-matrix})$ for a matrix descending the presentation matrix of $N$. Here the system $(A_\lambda)$ is given, not constructed, which is the form in which the proof of Lemma Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre, line 32992) uses the construction twice (for $R\to S$ over the $R_\lambda$, and for $S\to S'$ with $M$ over the $S_\lambda$). Clause (4) asks a localization at some multiplicative subset (00QX (5): at a prime ideal); clause (5) is the essentially-of-finite-presentation form of the 'in particular $M=M_\lambda\otimes_{S_\lambda}S$' of Lemma Tag 00R1 (lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation, line 32593).

proof.text: Use finite presentation only to obtain finite type and Small P. Replace P by its Shrink algebra in the base universe. Apply exists_finiteType_ring_system to construct a compatible tail of finite type stage algebras with colimit ring-equivalent to P. This uses finite generators, not descent of relations.

Transport the given localization along the colimit ring equivalence, using IsLocalization.of_ringEquiv_left, and apply exists_localized_filtered_ring_system. It provides the localized diagram B, colimit cocone β, and compatible essentially-finite-type maps from the unlocalized stages.

Define τ₀ᵢ by composing the stage structure map σᵢ with the localization map. RingHom.EssFiniteType.comp gives its essential finite type. Its composite with βᵢ equals τ followed by the original colimit leg, hence is local; isLocalHom_of_comp gives locality of τ₀ᵢ. Naturality of the localization transformation and of σ proves naturality of τ₀. Each Bᵢ is local because βᵢ is local into T, by RingHom.domain_isLocalRing. Cocone naturality expresses βᵢ as βⱼ composed with a transition map, so isLocalHom_of_comp proves locality of every transition map. No local-transition assumption on the original system is needed in this argument.

theorem exists_limit_module_ring_data_core
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    [∀ i : I, IsLocalRing (F.obj i)] [IsLocalRing c.pt]
    (hF : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (hcLocal : ∀ i : I, IsLocalHom (c.ι.app i).hom)
    (T : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing T] (τ : c.pt →+* T) [IsLocalHom τ]
    (P : Type p) [CommRing P] [Algebra c.pt P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation c.pt P]
    (W : Submonoid P) (f : P →+* T)
    (hf : f.comp (algebraMap c.pt P) = τ)
    (hT : letI := f.toAlgebra; IsLocalization W T) :
    ∃ i₀ : I,
      ∃ (B : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
        (β : B ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj T),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk T β)) ∧
        ∃ (τ₀ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, F.obj i.1 →+* B.obj i),
          (∀ i, IsLocalHom (τ₀ i)) ∧ (∀ i, (τ₀ i).EssFiniteType) ∧
          (∀ i, (β.app i).hom.comp (τ₀ i) = τ.comp (c.ι.app i.1).hom) ∧
          (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
            (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.comp (τ₀ i) =
              (τ₀ j).comp (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
          (∀ i, IsLocalRing (B.obj i)) ∧
          (∀ i, IsLocalHom ((β.app i).hom)) ∧
          (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
            IsLocalHom (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
